name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.17.2 polishes the construction menu and English/Dutch descriptions. Native separators divide Location, Station type/Platform length, and Fences into three sections. The fence label is shortened to Fences (Hekken in Dutch). Location buttons read Underground, Surface, Elevated, with Surface selected by default. The location row uses the full panel width to show complete labels, and each option explains its entrance and track level. Visible Metro wording is replaced by Light Rail. This clean-up changes the menu index meanings to 1=underground, 2=surface, 3=elevated; use a fresh test save. The named API v1 placements and station geometry remain unchanged. The user confirmed placement and operation of all three station placements in 0.17.0, and visually placed all platform lengths; operation at each length was not separately tested. Current automated tests preserve the same functional output for equivalent station choices. Fixed v1 stairs/end infills and the underground hall remain core-owned.
